entities.name: Lucius Valerius Poplicola Potitus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Valerius Poplicola Potitus was a patrician who, together with Marcus Horatius Barbatus, opposed the second decemvirate in 449 BC when that body showed despotic tendencies. In honor of their efforts, the pair were elected consuls for the remainder of that year.
